seating.notes: Not finalised. Fionnuala Ó Dálaigh is left-handed and needs her left side open, but it is not yet confirmed whether that means the left end as seen from the room or the audience's right-hand end. Awaiting client decision. Pshemislav Gribovsky's seat and needs, and whether the top table is raised, are also unconfirmed. If it is raised, a compliant ramp is required. Draft seating is due Thu 5 Nov.

bar.alcohol_from: Actual end of the keynote (about 20:30, livestreamed). The reception is alcohol-free, with no welcome sparkling and no wine on tables before then.

transport.provider: TBC. Coachline is not to be approached or booked. Quotes are being sought from at least two other operators.

accessibility: Step-free throughout: drop-off, terrace, Long Gallery, Orangery, dining, indoor-accessible toilet and coach boarding
Door widths of at least 800 mm, to be confirmed for a power chair
Compliant ramp if the top table or stage is raised
Temporary toilets, if used, must include an accessible unit
At least one wheelchair-accessible coach with lift or ramp and a trained driver
Hard-standing, lit boarding point and lit route to the terrace after dark
Evacuation arrangement for the wheelchair user
Venue first-aider and nearest A&E noted
